gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 42.677m (technical provisions note). The report does not present an explicit, separate 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure or a claims development triangle suitable for calculating aggregate prior year development, so a quantified prior-year movement is not available from the disclosed notes. The report does, however, identify a named 2014 event (Hurricane Odile) which damaged a port in Mexico and left a current gross outstanding of GBP 3.2m, with the remainder of outstanding movements described as smaller attritional claims below reinsurance recovery thresholds.
